blocks.text: The Alive Luxury Private Detox Retreat is a five star, one on one detox experience designed to cleanse your body, restore your health, reset your habits, and bring you back to feeling clear, light, and full of vitality again. This is not a surface level body cleanse or a wellness escape. It is a private luxury detox retreat created to deliver deep, powerful change across your body, your mind, and your life.
In your own private luxury retreat villa, as the only guest, you are supported by a full expert team working exclusively with you.

Your program is built around advanced biomedical detox, customised nutritional cleanse plans, and food as medicine, helping your body release what has been weighing it down, repair from the inside out, and restore energy, clarity, and balance. IV therapy, ozone therapy, biohacking, and restorative treatments accelerate the shift, so you feel lighter, cleaner, more energised, and deeply renewed within days.
But true detox goes further than the body.

This is also where you detox the mind. The noise softens. The mental fog lifts. The pull towards old habits, overindulgence, and emotional heaviness begins to fade, replaced with clarity, calm, and a natural sense of ease. Through meditation, breathwork, movement, private coaching, and healing work, you begin to feel like yourself again, clear, steady, and fully reconnected.

And then, even deeper, you detox your life. You step away from the patterns, habits, and ways of living that have been draining you, and begin creating something cleaner, lighter, and far more aligned with how you want to feel every day.
This is what makes Alive different.
You are not just cleansing your body. You are releasing what no longer belongs in your system, your mind, and your life, so you leave feeling lighter, clearer, energised, and fully renewed.
